info.name: List or search for user details

params.name: prefix
params.description: Filter by a prefix string matched against username, first name, last name, provider key, and DN.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of items per page.

params.name: asc_order
params.description: Whether results are in ascending order.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort results by field. Defaults to `first_name`. When `prefix` is specified and `sort` is not, results are ordered by search relevance score instead.

params.name: user_role
params.description: Filter by user role. `|` represents logical OR.

params.name: account_status
params.description: Filter by account status. `|` represents logical OR.

items.docs:
This endpoint lists local users. When called with a prefix
parameter, it searches for local users matching the prefix.

By default, results are sorted by first name, then last name, then
username, then email. Use the `sort` parameter to sort by a
different field. When `prefix` is specified and `sort` is not,
results are ordered by relevance to the prefix. When both `prefix`
and `sort` are specified, the `sort` field takes precedence. The

info.name: Create a user from caller-supplied details (SAML, password, PAM, proxied, OAuth2 except with Google)

items.docs:
This endpoint creates the given user.

- This endpoint is used only for SAML, OAuth2 (non-Google), password, PAM, and proxied
  authentication. All other authentication providers should
  use the [PUT /v1/users](#createPullUser) endpoint.
- Administrator access is required to create *other* users.

info.name: Create a user using details from a remote authentication provider (LDAP, OAuth2 with Google)

items.docs:
This endpoint creates the given user on the Posit Connect server.

- This endpoint is used only for LDAP and OAuth2 with Google
  authentication. All other authentication providers should
  use the [POST /v1/users](#createPushUser) endpoint.
- Unlike the [POST /v1/users](#createPushUser) endpoint, publisher or administrator
  access is required to access this endpoint.

info.name: Search for user details from a remote provider

items.docs:
This endpoint is used to support operations against users who
do not have a Posit Connect account, such as
[creating LDAP and OAuth2 with Google users](#createPullUser).
See [GET /v1/users](#getUsers) for listing users.

This endpoint searches for users on Posit Connect and on
your LDAP or OAuth2 with Google system.

Results are first sorted based on similarity to the `prefix`
and then by first name, last name, username, and email.

- This endpoint can be used only by LDAP or OAuth2 with Google

Get detailed information on a specific user.

The `email` field is not populated for non-admins when
[`Server.HideEmailAddresses`](../admin/appendix/configuration/index.md#Server.HideEmailAddresses) is enabled. The `external_id` field is only
visible to administrators and to users viewing their own record.

This endpoint updates a given user and returns the updated
user properties. Note that it returns only the properties that
can be modified by this endpoint.

If the authentication provider allows it:

- a user can change their own user properties.
- another user's properties can be changed with administrator
  access.

This endpoint locks or unlocks a given user account.

- Unlocking a user is prohibited if that additional user would
violate the user account limit specified by the Posit Connect product
license.
- Administrator access is required to access this endpoint.
- Users are able to lock themselves.
